tradeoptimizer.picker.title: Trade Picker
tradeoptimizer.config.title: Trade Picker Settings
tradeoptimizer.config.vanillaPricing.tip:
OFF (default): every trade shows the lowest possible vanilla price.
ON: trades use vanilla's randomized price range. Prices are seeded per villager and trade, so the picker preview always matches what you pay.

Note: this setting is server-side. On a dedicated server it must be changed in config/tradeoptimizer.json on the server directly.
OFF (default): you can choose up to two enchanted books at every villager level.
ON: the number of book picks per level is capped to how many book trades vanilla actually offers there (usually one), so the rest of your picks must be non-book trades — a vanilla-accurate librarian economy.

Note: this setting is server-side. On a dedicated server it must be changed in config/tradeoptimizer.json on the server directly.
tradeoptimizer.config.hidePickedTrades.t:
OFF (default): trades this villager already sells still show in the picker, marked with a green check.
ON: they are hidden from the picker entirely, so you only ever see trades you don't have yet.

Note: this setting is server-side. On a dedicated server it must be changed in config/tradeoptimizer.json on the server directly.
tradeoptimizer.config.gearMode.headline: Headline
tradeoptimizer.config.gearMode.tip:
How enchanted GEAR trades (sword, bow, armor, tools, fishing rod) let you choose. Books are unaffected.

Headline (default): pick the main enchantment you want; the game still rolls its level and any vanilla bonus enchantments — keeps vanilla's surprise and balance.
Single: pick exactly one enchantment AND its level. You get only that, nothing extra.

(A full combo builder is coming in a later update.)

Note: this setting is server-side. On a dedicated server it must be changed in config/tradeoptimizer.json on the server directly.
tradeoptimizer.config.costScaling: Cost scaling for picked enchants (per profession):
tradeoptimizer.config.costScaling.tip:
OFF (default): picked enchanted gear / tipped arrows use the normal price (follows Vanilla Pricing).
ON: rarer and higher-level enchantments cost more emeralds, up to vanilla's price cap — a little balance so picking the best isn't free.

Note: curing a villager still drops prices the usual vanilla way. This setting is server-side.
